verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents namespaces as its isolation unit: you can list and paginate them by prefix, the docs recommend isolated per-test namespaces, cache warming and pinning work per namespace, and one documented per-namespace limit exists (up to 256TB with sharding). The docs also position the object-storage design as roughly 10x cheaper. However, the evidence never explicitly presents namespace-per-tenant as the tenancy pattern, never states cheap per-tenant economics, and documents no limits on namespace count. missing for 10: explicit namespace-per-tenant guidance, documented limits on namespace count and per-namespace quotas, per-tenant cost evidence, independent corroboration of running many tenants at scale.
